Nina (AE): Heads-up: Riverbank wants a fast POC to replace CompetitorX with Redwood. Scope: prompt parity, response diffs, per-1k message cost delta, and security questionnaire handoff. Can eng + security split tasks?
Kai (ML Eng): I can run the diff harness. Need a redacted 48h prompt dump, median/p95 token lengths, and whether they use streaming token hooks.
Nina (AE): They stream; peak concurrency ~520. I'll ask for the dump, traffic histogram, and their legal contact.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): POC plan: 1) tiny adapter to map CompetitorX payload -> Redwood API, 2) replay traffic on a sandbox pool, 3) run golden prompt suite and produce diff report. I'll repo a starter proxy.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): adapter example (pseudo):
POST /proxy -> map body.text -> {"input": body.text, "model":"redwood-medium", "temperature": 0}
Kai (ML Eng): Parity runs: temperature=0, top_p=0.0; capture tokenizer outputs. CompetitorX uses a different tokenization and light postprocessing, so comparator must canonicalize whitespace and strip IDs/dates.
Ravi (Product): For pricing delta I need sequence histograms and percent streaming. I'll model hosted vs dedicated vs Private and show batching/quantization impacts. Please surface long-context flows if any.
Marta (Security): I'll start the SQ. Need answers for retention, SSO (SAML/SCIM), KMS/BYOK, SIEM forwarding, and egress IP allowlist. Note: BYOK + Private is a common bank requirement.
Hugo (SRE): If we replay prod-shaped traffic we should run on isolated test pool and rate-limit to avoid noisy neighbor effects. I can provision a sandbox pool and temporary egress IPs.
Kai (ML Eng): One more: CompetitorX exposes a "seed" param for determinism. We don't expose seed externally, but we can run internal fixed-seed experiments for POC and include results in the report.
Zoe (Solutions Eng): Comparator checklist: normalize dates/IDs, canonicalize whitespace, apply competitor postproc, token-level Levenshtein, and semantic sim (embeddings) with threshold. I'll include a quick report template.
Nina (AE): Timeline suggestion (9 business days): Days 1-2 adapter + infra, Days 3-4 replay + capture, Days 5-6 parity analysis, Day 7 prompt mitigations, Day 8 pricing + SQ draft, Day 9 joint review.
Ravi (Product): I'll prepare a sensitivity table: batching window vs latency vs cost and a per-1k message delta vs CompetitorX using their sample stats.
Marta (Security): I'll flag any contract blockers (SOC2, retention windows, customer-managed keys) early. Nina, please add legal once SQ draft is ready.
replay-bot: replay job created by Zoe - job_id=14523 - ETA 13m.
Nina (AE): Next steps: 1) Riverbank to upload sample + SQ, 2) Zoe deploys adapter and starts replay, 3) Marta starts SQ answers, 4) Ravi + Kai run parity and cost model. Sync in 7 business days. Please ack. :thumbsup:
Kai (ML Eng): ack
Zoe (Solutions Eng): ack
Ravi (Product): ack
Marta (Security): ack
Hugo (SRE): ack
Nina (AE): thanks 44d
